asset: 2000 Nissan Altima (L30) - fully disassemblable Blender asset

coordinate_system.convention: +X = forward (nose), +Y = left side, +Z = up, Z=0 = ground
coordinate_system.origin: mid-point of the wheelbase, projected to the ground plane

standalone_reassembly.note: This module reassembles on its own: every row carries the part's assembled world position in offset_m, so the disassemble / reassemble operators shipped in altima2000_assembly_tools.py work on this file unchanged.
standalone_reassembly.mapping_to_master: row['master_index'] is the part's 1-based index in the master manifest; row['name'] is identical in both, and row['collection'] is the same sub-collection name.
